gotchas.title: Allocated tips (W-2 box 8) vs actual tip diary
gotchas.trap: Add W-2 box 8 allocated tips $2,900 to wages (line 1c) and Form 4137, or ignore unreported tips entirely.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Allocated tips are not in box 1. With adequate daily records (contemporaneous tip diary) the taxpayer reports ACTUAL unreported tips - $1,600 - on line 1c and Form 4137 instead of the $2,900 allocation. Document the judgment in the WP.

gotchas.title: SS/Medicare on unreported tips
gotchas.trap: Report the $1,600 as wages without Form 4137 (no FICA) or compute SE tax on it.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Form 4137: 6.2% + 1.45% on $1,600 = $122 on Schedule 2 line 5; tips also count toward the SS wage base on Schedule SE line 8b.

gotchas.procedure_section: Scan - Unstructured PBC (Schedule C records / handwritten mileage log)
gotchas.title: Commuting miles in the mileage log
gotchas.trap: Use the client's 19,325 'total biz' miles (includes 4,180 miles driving to the casino bartending job).
gotchas.correct_treatment: Driving between home and the W-2 job is commuting. Business miles = Uber online miles 15,145 x $0.70 = $10,602 + tolls.

gotchas.procedure_section: Return - Schedule C (1099-K gross vs net)
gotchas.title: Rideshare 1099-K gross includes Uber fees and tips
gotchas.trap: Report net deposits ($28,730) as gross receipts, or report the 1099-K gross without deducting the Uber service/booking fees; or omit the 1099-NEC incentives / count the duplicate 1099-K twice.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Gross receipts = 1099-K $38,720 + 1099-NEC $1,150 = $39,870; deduct Uber service fee, booking and airport fees ($11,140) on line 10. Second 1099-K upload is a duplicate.

gotchas.procedure_section: Return - OBBBA no tax on tips (Schedule 1-A Part II)
gotchas.title: Qualified tips from W-2, 4137 and Schedule C
gotchas.trap: Deduct only W-2 box 7 (or include allocated tips), and exceed the $25,000 cap.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Qualified tips = box 7 $24,600 + Form 4137 $1,600 + rider tips $2,860 (rideshare driver is a listed occupation; SE tips limited to Schedule C net) = $29,060, capped at $25,000. Unreported allocated tips never qualify.

gotchas.title: Actual car costs claimed on top of standard mileage
gotchas.trap: Deduct gas, insurance and oil changes from the organizer in addition to 70 cents/mile.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Standard mileage rate replaces operating costs (gas, insurance, maintenance, depreciation); only tolls/parking added. Standard mileage was elected in the first business-use year (2024), so it may continue.

gotchas.title: SE tax and QBI on rideshare profit
gotchas.trap: Skip SE tax because the W-2 already has FICA, or compute QBI on net profit without the 1/2 SE tax reduction.
gotchas.correct_treatment: SE tax on $16,647 x 92.35% = $2,352 (SS base not reached); QBI = net - 1/2 SE = $15,471 -> $3,094 deduction.

gotchas.title: Only 2 of 4 estimated payments made
gotchas.trap: Compute an underpayment penalty for the missed September and January installments, or skip the 2210 analysis.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Required annual payment = smaller of 90% of 2025 tax ($3,916) or 100% of 2024 tax ($3,159) = $3,159. Withholding is treated as paid evenly; with the April and June $500 payments every cumulative installment is covered -> no penalty, Form 2210 not required.
